placement.claim: Permanent shared placement is deferred pending further dogfooding. Review-local use of equivalent evidence-lineage semantics is permitted without establishing a shared owner.

reopening_conditions: A proposal-research claim and a specialist review finding exercise the candidate and show which identity, provenance, sensitivity, authority, and lineage properties are genuinely shared.
A domain consumer requires incompatible statement or transition semantics that make one shared contract misleading.
A domain profile exercises semantic freshness maintenance, advisory applicability assessment, and downstream reliance against the same evidence baseline and shows which roles are genuinely distinct.
Observed concurrency, external evidence, or runtime recovery requires semantics that Git-backed artifacts and on-demand revalidation cannot preserve.
One real research claim and one review finding exercise the proposed common contract.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized portfolio owner

relationships.rationale: If this candidate is selected as the shared semantic owner, revision-bound review artifacts can consume its stable statement identity, evidence baselines, provenance, sensitivity, scoped authority, and non-destructive lineage. The review profile causally requires those consequences, not acceptance of this particular placement hypothesis.
Proposal packets may reference evidence-lineage artifacts while retaining ownership of proposal identity, current meaning, lifecycle, uncertainty, relationships, and decision authority.
